definitions.short: Bukki , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1231. Buqqi בֻּקִּי proper name, masculine ( id. ) — 1 a Danite chief Num 32:22 . 2 a descendant of Aaron 1 Chronicles 5:31 (twice in verse); 1Chr 6:31 ; Ezra 7:4 .

occurrences.englishText: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
